# Fellgate Radio Dispatch - trunked groups

Shared folder for the control room.

- groups/  loading sheets for each talk group
- masts/  coverage notes from the field team

turns.prompt: A controller new to Fellgate Radio Dispatch asked what an Erlang is on a trunk loading sheet; it is one channel busy for a full hour, so the traffic a group carries is its speech minutes in the hour divided by sixty. Group T-19 carries 342 speech minutes in the busy hour across its 7 channels. Give the traffic that group carries, as a single number in Erlangs with no unit in the reply. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
